g.text: a) Insert cables inside the cable chain ""twist the cables while pushing them inside
b) Attach 11 units of cable chain to the male end
c) Pay attention to the bend direction of the chain and install it in the correct orientation
a) 将电缆插入电缆链中，“插入时扭转电缆以加快速度”
b) 将11个电缆链连接到公头端
c) 注意电缆链的弯曲方向，并按正确方向安装

g.onmousemove: ShowToolTip(evt,'6',"0241_M3x10 socket head cap screw Black")
